description: AdvanVis - Smart Line and Trend labels the points that matter and explains the trend in plain English: last year as a dashed line, the budget with the gap shaded, the difference for every period, a projection with its likely range, and findings you can trust. FREE FEATURES (no licence needed, no watermark) • Line, smooth, stepped, area and stacked area; up to six measures or a Legend • Small multiples (a chart per series) and a second Y axis • Smart labels: first, last, highest and lowest points, with series names at the line ends • Show values as running total, year to date or an index (first period = 100) • Comments from your data: a text field becomes numbered notes on the line and a list under the chart • Trend line and moving average, peaks and troughs, average, median and fixed lines, a reference band and a shaded period (Analytics pane) • Zoom slider for long series, and fetch more data up to 30,000 periods • Conditional formatting (fx) for point colours, colour-blind safe schemes • Cross-highlighting, cross-filtering, drill-down, tooltips, Show condition • Basic headline, keyboard navigation, screen reader text and high contrast support PRO FEATURES (additional purchase may be required; one-month free trial through Microsoft AppSource) • Compare to last period: a dashed line and the change on the last label • Target or budget: a target line with the gap shaded, scored…
